classification.rule: Explicit symbol-name tokens only; not an instruction or call-graph classification

symbol_policy: Half-open nonzero STT_FUNC ranges; shortest range, highest start, lexical alias; zero-size symbols infer no range

proof_cost_model.kind: Structural row model, not a proof or timing estimate
proof_cost_model.limitation: Column counts require the admitted opcode encoding plan. No RV64 continuation or aggregate proof is provided. Crypto attribution does not predict provider work.
